description: Triggers a vibration on the device.

vibrate.signature: static vibrate(pattern: number | number[], repeat: boolean)
vibrate.description: Triggers a vibration. On Android, passing a number triggers a vibration for that duration. Passing an array triggers a pattern [0, 500, 200, 500] (wait 0ms, vibrate 500ms, wait 200ms, vibrate 500ms). On iOS, duration is ignored and it vibrates for a fixed duration.
